buildCommand: npx prisma generate && (DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED:-${POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING:-$DATABASE_URL}}" npx prisma db push --skip-generate || (sleep 20 && DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED:-${POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING:-$DATABASE_URL}}" npx prisma db push --skip-generate) || echo '[deploy] db push saltato: database non raggiungibile, schema invariato') && npm run build
